### Borea v0.6.23

A patch release for game settings in new instances. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### New

- A new instance now starts with a copy of the settings of the game without mods (its settings.toml), so graphics, controls and sound are already set up. Borea copies them once, when it creates the instance. Later changes in the instance stay in the instance and do not change the game.
- The new instance dialog offers "Settings from the game" (the default), "Game defaults" and your saved presets. Imports from the game, packs, modlist links and files, and `borea instance create` start with the game settings too. A duplicate starts with the settings of the instance it copies.
- New instance menu item "Copy settings to the game without mods". It asks first, does not run while the game runs, and keeps the old settings of the game as a backup in the Backups folder.

#### Simplified Chinese

- Simplified Chinese covers every text of v0.6.22 again. Thanks to @kuxiaowo.
